steps.name: Magic Soul (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Sarasvati] in the "Isolation Room", then find [Mari] in "Atlantis".

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Adventurer, you've come as promised.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never expected you to appear so suddenly back there, Sarasvati.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: The situation was urgent. I had no choice.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's something I want to ask. You already knew about Bergelmir, didn't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said weapons like Bergelmir destroyed worlds.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Yes. That is true.
(The holographic keyboard in front of Sarasvati vanishes, replaced by a new holographic screen.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: This happened long ago. It is the history of a place beyond the Great Wall, rather than here. You already know something of it, Adventurer...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Humanity has always fought for its own interests. The weak disappeared, and the strong survived to become history.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: War was a constant in that history. And war always involved power used to defeat those designated as enemies.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You mean weapons?

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Yes. Weapons became ever more sophisticated, progressing from the ability to defeat an opponent to the power to destroy an entire planet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Weapons like Bergelmir...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Yes. Bergelmir is a weapon made by the ancestors of this world's inhabitants...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Its creators branded the homes of anyone whose interests opposed theirs as "evil" and ordered their complete destruction.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Some planets disappeared without a trace. Bergelmir's arrival here was no coincidence.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: But Bergelmir realized this was not a planet it should destroy, and chose to remain.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I have been analyzing why, but I have yet to find an answer. One thing is certain: the machine developed a soul...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: You have seen something similar in the form of magic golems, also known as MGs.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I understand this planet contains many mysterious things. Do you know anyone knowledgeable about golems with souls?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Golems with souls... Most golems are shaped by the will of their users...)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Please leave out what happened in Oneiro Forest when you ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll look into it.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I will await your return.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No one comes to mind... Maybe I should ask Mari in Atlantis? She had an Eraser...)

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: Hello, %s. It's been a while since you visited Atlantis!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. How have you been?

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: Did you need something? You came looking for me, after all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You ask Mari about magic golems with souls.)

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: Huh...

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: MGs with souls? Artificial intelligence, maybe...

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: There's AI advanced enough to talk to people, but nothing with a fully independent will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: Is it something magical? Maybe someone from Freios would know more.

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: I've heard the dwarves have incredible technology. Why not ask them?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Thanks, Mari.

lines.speaker: 마리
lines.text: No problem. Good luck!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Should I ask Dorun in Archi City, then...?)

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Oh, brave hero! What an honor for you to visit me, Dorun!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hero...? I'm not really...

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: I, Dorun, will be of service! You need only ask, brave hero!

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Just say the word!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. The reason I've come is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You ask Dorun about magic golems with souls.)

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Ahahaha...

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: I, Dorun, will be of service! Ask me anything except questions about magic golems!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahahaha. I see.

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Ah! I've heard there's an outstanding expert on magic golems in the Guild Alliance city!

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: A young girl with animal ears...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that girl I passed when I went to see Dayna...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Dorun! I'll be going!

lines.speaker: 도룬
lines.text: Please visit again, brave hero! I, Dorun, will be of service!

steps.name: Magic Soul (4)
steps.objective: Defeat [Bergelmir] in "Dreaming Oneiro" and obtain <Bergelmir's Heart Fragment>.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hello... You came in here a little while ago, didn't you? You're %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. Your name is... Narsha, isn't it? Ambrosia and Anise mentioned you before.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Really? What work are those two trying to make me do now...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, nothing like that. I came because I wanted to ask you something.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Let's hear it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you heard of magic golems having souls?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Do you know about the souls? It sounds like you already know something...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure what you mean. The reason I'm asking about magic golems is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly explain that you encountered and fought something like a giant golem in Oneiro Forest.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: You've done a lot since arriving. I knew you were busy, but...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You knew about me?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Of course. You're famous. President Dayna told me you've saved the world several times.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, well, then...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Some magic golems can occasionally move without a power source. Almost as if they have minds of their own...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I've heard that golems like that often destroyed villages in ancient times. They needed a way to control them.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Magic is more widespread in Freios than on other continents, so some people here have the power to control magic golems. Myself included...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: That's how professions using magic golems developed, along with research into them.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The Silvaria Empire's Magic Bureau conducts much of that research and defines the terminology. They call the seemingly conscious mind of a golem that requires control a "magic soul."

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It's different from the soul of an ordinary living thing, like a human or an animal. We don't fully understand it yet... But magic souls can be transferred...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: They're definitely different from artificial intelligence.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Does that answer your question, Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, to some extent. I'll be going, then...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: W-wait...
(Narsha catches hold of %s's collar.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Adventurer, I have a favor to ask.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: There's something I'd like to investigate further. If you don't mind, could you put off leaving for a little while?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What can I do?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I don't know if anything remains, but you might be able to find it again.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Could you find a part from that golem and bring it to me? Or anything similar... Then I can investigate more closely!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wow, her eyes are practically sparkling... She's just like Ambrosia and Anise. No wonder they're friends.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are things I want to know too, so I'll go. Wait for me.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I will!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll have to return to Oneiro. I wonder if any trace of Bergelmir remains...

steps.name: Magic Soul (5)
steps.objective: Defeat [Chloris] in the "Magic Academy Main Building" and obtain <Spellbook: Understanding Space-Time>. Then find [Sarasvati] in "Isolation Room 3".

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I've been waiting, Adventurer.
(Narsha's eyes are fixed on the object in %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here you go, Narsha. It wasn't easy to find.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Thank you, Adventurer. So this is a part from that golem.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Let's take a look...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Could you wait a moment?
(Narsha goes into what appears to be a storage room and returns carrying something.)

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The part you brought is definitely different from any magic golem component I've seen. Its technology seems far more advanced than anything in this world today.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Look at this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That looks like an old part.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Yes, it is. An old component... A relic, really. It was discovered in the El Anoir Mountains. It dates back to the Twilight, when the gods fought.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: A great being made and animated a golem back then. This piece fell off it.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: See the markings engraved on this relic and the part you brought...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They're the same. Wait, that doesn't make sense...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I don't know why that golem was in Moros, in Eastland... But one thing is certain...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The golem the gods used and the one you saw in Oneiro Forest appear to be the same kind.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: And there are signs of a transfer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A transfer?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Would you take a look at Madori?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Madori?

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Madori is the magic golem on my shoulder. I transferred its magic soul from a giant body into a small one.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's a way to shrink a large magic golem? I've never heard of that...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: The Magic Bureau helped. It's still a work in progress, but think of it as moving the golem's consciousness, its magic soul, into a different vessel.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: That's the current technology, and it's still being researched... But this golem seems to have undergone that process already.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I'm sorry I can't give you a more definite answer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's fine. This is plenty.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Oh! I read a book written by the headmaster of Xerenis Magic Academy. It discussed space-time using a magic golem part as an example!

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: I believe there are quite a few copies around. If you explain what you need, you might be able to get one.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It might help whoever sent you here, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you. I'll find that book.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Please come back sometime. There's something else I'd like to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sometime? All right. I'll head to Xerenis Hill, then...

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: Goodbye, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 나르샤
lines.text: It feels like something strange is happening... What could it be...? I'll ask the president later.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Adventurer. I was lost in thought and didn't notice your arrival. What are you holding...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I went to see someone knowledgeable about golems, as you asked.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She said bringing you this book might be more helpful.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Thank you. I am confined to this place... If you have the opportunity, please thank her on my behalf.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Would you tell me what you learned?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You recount your conversation with Narsha, including the questions about space-time and magic souls...)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: One moment, please.
(The book you gave Sarasvati rises toward the enormous screen, then melts into it like snow.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sarasvati...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Souls that can be transferred...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Technology used in weapons thousands of years ago, yet only now beginning to develop...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: And an organization within a nation carrying out that development...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Different timelines...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Could that mean...?)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: The cracks in the Great Wall have caused so many errors. It was fortunate I could stop space-time in Oneiro Forest and enter it that day...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: There are many suspicious details, but let us stop here for now. I will investigate the rest at my own pace and let you know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Some of my questions have been answered too.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: I suspect you will have much more to do in the future, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Ah, if you have a chance, please visit my troublesome older sister. I really am sorry to ask this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. There's always going to be plenty for me to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be going, Sarasvati. I still have things to take care of...

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: Of course...
(After confirming that %s has left D-Lab, Sarasvati calls up a new screen.)

lines.speaker: 사라스바티
lines.text: It seems the time has come to prepare a few protocols I have never used...
